title: Genetic architecture and inheritance patterns of Leber hereditary optic neuropathy among 419 Chinese pedigrees carrying the ND4 11778G>A mutation.
intervention: genetic and clinical analysis of m.11778G>A pedigrees (no pharmacological intervention evaluated)

outcomes.name: haplogroup enrichment
outcomes.effect_text: Haplogroups D4j, M7, M9, and M10 are significantly enriched in maternally inherited families with elevated disease penetrance

outcomes.name: inheritance patterns
outcomes.effect_text: 209 pedigrees contain only single affected individuals
